create_extension_dtype: create a custom pandas ExtensionDtype subclass with name, type, and construct_array_type methods
build_registered_extension_dtype: build a registered extension dtype using the register_extension_dtype decorator on a custom ExtensionDtype class
test_dtype_equality: test whether two extension dtypes are equal using __eq__ with string or instance comparison
find_registered_dtype: find a registered extension dtype from a string name using the Registry.find method
summarize_extension_dtype: summarize the ExtensionDtype interface including abstract methods type, name, and construct_array_type
